# Creature

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Creature)*

Any being in the game, including a player's character, is a creature. *See also* "[Creature Type](Creature-Type.md)."
